extracted.intended_audience: students, researchers, journalists, and general readers seeking country/geographic reference data
extracted.subtask_description: A country/profile factbook template describing the required fields and data to include for a country, territory, or ocean (geography, people, government, economy, communications, transportation, military, transnational issues). Use for producing consistent country reference entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background / Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Brief historical and contextual background summarizing key events leading to the current status (e.g., first inhabitants, colonization, independence, major political transitions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include dates, major historical turning points, and short narrative context for the polity/region. Examples: indigenous peoples, colonial history, independence date, periods of authoritarian rule or democratization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic description of where the country/region is situated (e.g., continent, relation to seas/oceans, bordering countries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State clear region identifiers (e.g., 'Southern South America, bordering the South Atlantic Ocean, between Chile and Uruguay').

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic coordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: Latitude and longitude tie point(s) for the country or region (e.g., '34 00 S, 64 00 W').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide coordinates for a representative central point such as capital, centroid, or pole (for oceans/Antarctica use 90° N/S, 0° E).

rubrics_metrics.name: Map references
rubrics_metrics.description: Map region labels used for cross-reference (e.g., 'South America', 'Antarctic Region').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the standard map region(s) under which the entry should be categorized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Area (total / land / water)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total area with breakdowns into land and water and any special notes (e.g., ice-covered vs ice-free in Antarctica).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric estimates and relevant qualifiers/notes (e.g., 'total: 14 million sq km; land: 14 million sq km (280,000 sq km ice-free, 13.72 million sq km ice-covered)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Area - comparative
rubrics_metrics.description: Comparative statement placing the country's area in relation to familiar entities (e.g., 'slightly less than 1.5 times the size of the US').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer one-sentence size comparisons to help reader comprehension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Length and description of international land borders (total km and by neighbor where applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List total length and break out individual borders with distances (e.g., 'total: 9,665 km; border countries: Bolivia 832 km, Brazil 1,224 km...'). If none, state '0 km'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coastline
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of coastline in kilometers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the official coastline length (e.g., 'Coastline: 4,989 km').

rubrics_metrics.name: Maritime claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Declared maritime zones and claims (e.g., territorial sea, contiguous zone, exclusive economic zone, continental shelf) and any caveats about recognition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State standard claim distances and notes about international recognition or disputes (examples: 'territorial sea: 12 nm; exclusive economic zone: 200 nm; note if claims not universally accepted').

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate
rubrics_metrics.description: General climate description with major regional variation and seasonal notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe dominant climate types, extremes, and notable seasonal variations (e.g., polar, tropical, temperate; mention warmest/coldest periods and regional contrasts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Terrain
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of major landforms and surface features (e.g., plains, plateaus, ice sheets, mountain ranges).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize dominant physiography and prominent subregions (e.g., 'rich plains of the Pampas, flat to rolling plateau of Patagonia, rugged Andes along western border').

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevation extremes
rubrics_metrics.description: Lowest and highest natural points with elevations and notes (e.g., 'lowest point: Laguna del Carbon -105 m; highest point: Cerro Aconcagua 6,960 m').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give numeric elevations and geographical locating information where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural resources
rubrics_metrics.description: List of principal natural resources and remarks on exploitation status (commercial/uncommercial).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include minerals, fuels, biological resources and note if unexploited or commercially exploited (e.g., 'iron ore, chromium... none presently exploited').

rubrics_metrics.name: Land use
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of land by major uses (arable land, permanent crops, other) with percentages and year of estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide percents and date of data (e.g., 'arable land: 12.31%; permanent crops: 0.48%; other: 87.21% (2001)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Irrigated land
rubrics_metrics.description: Area of irrigated land in square kilometers and date of estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give numeric value and year (e.g., '15,610 sq km (1998 est.)') or '0'/'NA' where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural hazards
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal natural hazards the country/region faces (e.g., hurricanes, blizzards, earthquakes, large icebergs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List hazards with regional/seasonal context (e.g., 'hurricanes and tropical storms (July to October); periodic droughts').

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - current issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Contemporary environmental problems and notable events (e.g., ozone hole, melting ice shelves, deforestation, water management).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize recent environmental concerns and scientific findings affecting ecosystems or human systems (include dates/examples where available).

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - note
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional noteworthy geographic observations or superlatives (e.g., 'coldest, windiest, highest, and driest continent').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concise salient facts that don't fit other fields (climate extremes, strategic notes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Population
rubrics_metrics.description: Total population with date of estimate and note about temporary inhabitants (e.g., research station populations in Antarctica).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State total and explain seasonal or non-indigenous population dynamics where applicable (e.g., 'varies from approximately 4,000 in summer to 1,000 in winter').

rubrics_metrics.name: Age structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage distribution of population by age cohorts (0-14, 15-64, 65+), sometimes with male/female breakouts and numeric counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide percentages and, where shown, male/female counts and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Median age
rubrics_metrics.description: Median age of total population and by sex with date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give total, male, and female median ages (e.g., 'total: 29.4 years; male: 28.9 years; female: 29.9 years (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Population growth and rates (birth, death, migration)
rubrics_metrics.description: Population growth rate, birth rate, death rate, and net migration rate with dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric rates per 1,000 or percent and year (e.g., 'Population growth rate: 0.6% (2004 est.); Birth rate: 17.7 births/1,000 population').

rubrics_metrics.name: Sex ratio
rubrics_metrics.description: Ratios of males to females at birth, by age groups, and total population.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present ratios for standard cohorts (at birth, under 15, 15-64, 65+, total).

rubrics_metrics.name: Infant mortality and life expectancy
rubrics_metrics.description: Infant mortality rate (per 1,000 live births) and life expectancy at birth by sex and total.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give numeric rates and year of estimate (e.g., 'Infant mortality: 20.18 per 1,000; Life expectancy total: 71.6 years').

rubrics_metrics.name: Total fertility rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Average number of children born per woman with date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the TFR value and year (e.g., '2.27 children born/woman (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Health - HIV/AIDS indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Adult prevalence rate, numbers living with HIV/AIDS, and deaths where reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report prevalence percent and absolute counts when available, with year of estimate or 'NA' if unavailable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nationality / Demonyms
rubrics_metrics.description: Noun and adjective forms for the country's people (e.g., 'noun: Antiguan(s), Barbudan(s); adjective: Antiguan, Barbudan').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List common English demonyms and adjectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethnic groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Major ethnic groups present in the population.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concise enumeration of principal ethnicities (e.g., 'black, British, Portuguese, Lebanese, Syrian').

rubrics_metrics.name: Religions
rubrics_metrics.description: Dominant religions and denominations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State principal faiths and any notable denominational breakdowns (e.g., 'Christian, predominantly Anglican').

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Official and commonly spoken languages and dialects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List official language(s) and notable local dialects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition used and literacy rates for total and by sex, with year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the literacy definition applied and numeric rates (e.g., 'definition: age 15 and over has completed five or more years of schooling; total: 89%').

rubrics_metrics.name: Country name and conventional forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventional short and long forms of the country/territory name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give recognized formal and short names (e.g., 'conventional long form: none; conventional short form: Antigua and Barbuda').

rubrics_metrics.name: Government type / Antarctic Treaty summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Form of government and, where relevant, the governing international agreements (e.g., Antarctic Treaty provisions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the constitutional or treaty-based governance framework, decision-making processes (e.g., 'decisions by consensus of consultative member nations'), and name key treaty articles and their effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capital
rubrics_metrics.description: Name of the capital city (or administrative center).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide commonly accepted capital; for territories, note special arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary subnational divisions (provinces, states, parishes, dependencies) and any notable annotations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List divisions by name and indicate dependencies or jointly administered areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence / Constitution / National holiday
rubrics_metrics.description: Dates of independence, constitution adoption, and official national day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the date and the historical source (e.g., 'Independence: 1 November 1981 (from UK); Constitution: 1 November 1981').

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal system
rubrics_metrics.description: Basis of the legal system and any extraterritorial application or special national laws (e.g., Antarctic Conservation Act).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe dominant legal tradition (common law, civil law), and list significant extra-territorial statutes or enforcement arrangements and penalties where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suffrage
rubrics_metrics.description: Voting age and basic suffrage rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State minimum voting age and whether suffrage is universal (e.g., '18 years of age; universal').

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Head of state, head of government, method of selection, cabinet composition, and current officeholders (as example data).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include how leaders are chosen and any notable appointment procedures and dates (e.g., 'chief of state: Queen ELIZABETH II, represented by Governor General...; head of government: Prime Minister Baldwin SPENCER (since 24 March 2004)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Legislative branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Structure (unicameral/bicameral), number of seats, election method, term lengths, and last election info.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe chamber names, appointment/election methods, seat counts, terms, and recent election dates/results where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Highest courts and judicial organization, including regional courts serving the country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Name the apex court(s) and any external/regional judicial institutions (e.g., 'Eastern Caribbean Supreme Court').

rubrics_metrics.name: Political parties and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Major political parties and their leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List principal parties and named leaders when provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political pressure groups and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Notable organized interest groups and their leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include major labor unions, movements, or civic organizations that affect policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: International organization participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Membership in major international organizations and treaties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List organizations (e.g., UN, IMF, WTO) and note accession years where provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation (in US/from US)
rubrics_metrics.description: Details of diplomatic missions to/from the United States including addresses and contact info where given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include chief of mission names, chancery addresses, telephone/fax numbers, and notes on accreditation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag description
rubrics_metrics.description: Textual description of the national flag's design and colors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise heraldic description sufficient to identify the flag (e.g., 'red, with an inverted isosceles triangle...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative summary of major economic activities, structural characteristics, and current economic concerns (e.g., tourism dominance, fisheries, resource exploitation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain economic drivers, constraints (water scarcity, labor shortages), and short-term prospects.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP and related aggregates
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimates of GDP (PPP), real growth rate, GDP per capita and composition by sector with year of estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric GDP figures, growth rates, per capita values, and sector shares (agriculture, industry, services).

rubrics_metrics.name: Poverty and income distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Population below poverty line and household income/consumption shares by decile when available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include statistics or 'NA' when not available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inflation rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Consumer price inflation rate with year of estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State percent and year (e.g., '0.4% (2000 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force and employment structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Total labor force, occupational distribution by sector, and unemployment rate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give numeric labor force size, percent distribution across agriculture/industry/services, and unemployment percent with years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget (revenues and expenditures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Government budget totals for revenues and expenditures with year of estimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric values and note any capital expenditure figures or missing data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agriculture / Industries / Exports and Imports
rubrics_metrics.description: Major agricultural products, principal industries, export/import commodities and principal trading partners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List key products and percent breakdowns for exports/imports when available (e.g., 'Exports - commodities: petroleum products 48%, manufactures 23%').

rubrics_metrics.name: External debt and economic aid
rubrics_metrics.description: External debt stock and recorded economic aid receipts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report dollar amounts and year of estimate (e.g., 'Debt - external: $231 million (1999); Economic aid - recipient: $2.3 million (1995)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency and exchange rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Official currency name, ISO code, and exchange rate to US dollar with historical values if provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide currency code (e.g., XCD), fixed rate notes and sequence of recent rates if shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Official government fiscal year start and end dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give the month/day range (e.g., '1 April - 31 March').

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications - telephones and broadcast
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts for main telephone lines, mobile cellular subscribers, broadcast stations, and related telecom infrastructure notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numbers with year (e.g., 'Telephones - main lines in use: 38,000 (2002)') and describe international connectivity (submarine cables, satellite earth stations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Television and radio ownership
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts for radios and televisions and number of broadcast stations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric estimates and years; note any special networks (e.g., AFAN at McMurdo).

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet - country code and usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Internet country code top-level domain (ccTLD), number of ISPs, hosts, and users where available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List .xx code and counts with years (e.g., '.ag; Internet hosts: 1,665 (2003); Internet users: 10,000 (2002)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - ports, harbors, and highways
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal ports and harbors, status of port development, and highway totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe whether developed ports exist, transfer methods (e.g., barges, helicopters), and highway lengths with years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Air transport facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and types of airports and landing facilities, runway surfaces and lengths, and operational limitations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide totals and breakdowns by runway length and surface types, note restrictions (seasonal, ICAO standards not met) and required approvals for landings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heliports
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of stations/sites with helicopter landing facilities and any restrictions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give numeric count and note 'restricted' status if applicable (e.g., '27 stations have restricted helicopter landing facilities').

rubrics_metrics.name: Merchant marine
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of registered ships, total gross tonnage, breakdown by ship type, and notes on foreign registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide counts and types and note ships registered in other countries/foreign-owned details where listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military - note / branches
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement on military presence and branches; any prohibitions (e.g., Antarctic Treaty prohibits measures of a military nature).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State legal restrictions and permitted uses (military allowed for scientific/peaceful use), and list domestic military branches where present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower and expenditures
rubrics_metrics.description: Military age, conscription status, and available manpower; military expenditure totals or percent of GDP when available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide age thresholds, conscription notes (e.g., 'no conscription'), and numeric spending if provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational issues - disputes and illicit activities
rubrics_metrics.description: International disputes (territorial or maritime) and transnational concerns like illicit drugs or unregulated fishing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize major dispute categories and note areas of concern (e.g., 'Antarctic Treaty freezes claims; several states reserve rights to submit continental shelf data').

rubrics_metrics.name: Page last updated / data vintage
rubrics_metrics.description: Date the entry was last updated or the vintage year(s) of the estimates provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Display a 'last updated' date and annotate years for individual statistics (e.g., '(2004 est.)', '(1998 est.)') so users can assess currency.
